$comment: Bipe regions (bipe ADR 0197). A region is what a chartered association covers. A core serves one region. An account's region comes from the server name of its user ID: each server in registries/bipe-servers.json belongs to exactly one region. floor: 'e2ee' federates with other regions, 'none' runs alone. phoneProofCountryCodes: the country codes whose numbers this region's core may prove and so make findable. A person with another number has the same account and security, and is found by handle, QR or invite. schemes: the verification schemes this region runs (ADR 0272, registries/schemes.json). The signed operator list (bipe-chat/bipe#645) adds operators under each region.
